_comment: Allowed-escapes policy (design Q-004). Third-party hosts a rendered mirror doc may request that the deployed strict CSP is SUPPOSED to block — analytics/trackers/ad-tags/parked-domain widgets. A matched request is reported as an `allowed-escape` (visible, non-failing); an UNMATCHED non-local request still fails the doc. Host matching is suffix-aware (an entry matches the host and its subdomains). Seeded from the non-local-request findings a read-only dynamic probe surfaced over the cache-2026-07-27-remastered baseline (localize + report-only, 20-doc sample, 2026-07-29). Missing wayback captures are NOT escapes — they are the fetch worklist (src/mapkeys.js).
